none: PAS FindID 1012507: Roman coin: radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin: Radiate of Claudius II (268-270); possibly a genius exerci issue though reverse does not match published versions. Obverse description: Radiate bust, possibly bare-shouldered and with short beard, right. Obverse inscription: IMP C CLAVDIVS A[VG]. Reverse description: Nude male standing left holding vertical spear/sceptre and angled sword/baton, cloak hangs from left shoulder, possibly Genius. Reverse inscription: possibly [--]CI. Diameter: 19.8mm, Weight: 2.66gms, die axis: 12
